title: Scholarly Prompt Lab: The Prompt as Method
description: A free, open-source, browser-based tool for designing, documenting and evaluating generative-AI prompts in humanities and social science research. It turns a research question into a structured scholarly prompt using the proposed CONTEXT framework (Conceptual grounding, Operationalisation, Situated knowledge, Traceability, Evaluation, Cross-model examination, Transparency), with analytical procedures drawn from the researcher's discipline and chosen theoretical frameworks; generates four-condition prompt-sensitivity studies; checks every quotation in a model's output against the researcher's own sources; suggests evaluation scores that the researcher must confirm; and drafts a report of AI-assisted methods. It takes particular care with languages and knowledge traditions that are under-represented in AI training data. Runs entirely in the browser: no AI model is called and no user files are uploaded.
